names.name: Bifoil Or Twablade
names.note: Bifoil/twayblade orchid with paired leaves; standard identification.

cul:036-bifoil-or-twablade.ref: Culpeper, Complete Herbal: Bifoil Or Twablade
cul:036-bifoil-or-twablade.text: There is another sort grows in wet grounds and marshes, which is somewhat different from the former. It is a smaller plant, and greener, having sometimes three leaves; the spike of the flowers is less than the former, and the roots of this do run or creep in the ground. They are often used by many to good purpose for wounds, both green and old, to consolidate or knit ruptures; and well it may, being a plant of Saturn.
